# ragx Guide

ragx is the easiest way to add production-grade RAG to your Python project.

## Installation

Install with pip: `pip install ragx`

## Quickstart

Use the async context manager to ingest documents and query them.

## Configuration

Configure the embedder, store, and LLM via RAGConfig.

## Stores

Three store options: memory (default), lance (persistent), postgresql (production).
